payments_target_ck.name: payments_target_ck
payments_target_ck.value: "payments"."rental_id" IS NOT NULL OR "payments"."reservation_id" IS NOT NULL

payments_sign_ck.name: payments_sign_ck
payments_sign_ck.value: ("payments"."kind" = 'PAYMENT' AND "payments"."amount" > 0) OR ("payments"."kind" = 'REFUND' AND "payments"."amount" < 0) OR ("payments"."kind" = 'REVERSAL' AND "payments"."amount" <> 0 AND "payments"."reverses_payment_id" IS NOT NULL)

rentals_amounts_ck.name: rentals_amounts_ck
rentals_amounts_ck.value: "rental_transactions"."subtotal" >= 0 AND "rental_transactions"."discount" >= 0 AND "rental_transactions"."extra_charges" >= 0 AND "rental_transactions"."tax_amount" >= 0 AND "rental_transactions"."late_fee" >= 0 AND "rental_transactions"."damage_fee" >= 0 AND "rental_transactions"."cancellation_fee" >= 0 AND "rental_transactions"."quantity" > 0
